Spanish Language and Culture

Radboud University

← Back to search
About this programme

A reliable curriculum comparison is currently unavailable. The external curriculum has unresolved requirements; no complete degree pathway is certified here.

Radboud Spanish Language and Culture studies the language, literatures and societies of the Spanish-speaking world. It combines advanced Spanish, linguistic and cultural analysis, regional study and independent research.

The current sources leave material questions about how the published requirements form one complete study pathway. We show only the supported, non-repeated allocation and withhold UCR alternatives while these questions remain unresolved.

Academic year: 2026–2027

External pathway: Supported allocation; complete cohort pathway unresolved

The bachelor is 180 EC. The 155 EC shown here excludes repeated entries across the annual year tables. This does not mean the degree lacks 25 EC: a coherent cohort sequence, alternating courses and the relation between research preparation and study abroad still need clarification. First-year mentoring, the diagnostic Dutch academic-language test and second-year mentoring carry no credits. Attendance and approved minor and free-choice rules also apply.
